1.FoodDes: <text|A favorite dessert of the nobility at imperial balls. Its ornate appearance complements the lavish banquets perfectly.|winter_story_text>
1.WeirdFoodDes: <text|It's a dessert you can eat to your heart's content without ruining your figure––a dream delicacy for every girl indeed. |actCook_italic>
1.IngrShortDes: <text|The key ingredients are Tree-heart Fruits and Lover's Pearls, which can be acquired in the Garden of Wonders.|winter_story_text>
1.Feature: With its ornate appearance, this dessert fits perfectly with the lavish banquets of the nobility.

2.FoodDes: <text|A famous Mauler dish prepared by smoking and sautéing rare snake meat to bring out its full aroma.|winter_story_text>
2.WeirdFoodDes: <text|Snake meat is a very malleable ingredient, so perhaps it can be sculpted into an exquisite decoration?|actCook_italic>
2.IngrShortDes: <text|The key ingredients are ‌Ringtailed Viper meat, ‌Scorpion Pincers, and ‌Oasis Grain spices‍, which can be acquired in the Quicksand Desert.|winter_story_text>
2.Feature: We need to bring out the snake meat's full aroma by smoking and sautéing it.

3.FoodDes: <text|Initially a common Lightbearer soup, this dish was created after a Wilder exchange student took home but made a mistake with the original recipe, resulting in a surprising product with great nourishing effect.|winter_story_text>
3.WeirdFoodDes: <text|Since this is an accidental recipe, a bit of imagination might yield rewarding results for you.|actCook_italic>
3.IngrShortDes: <text|The key ingredients are purple pumpkin, pure cowlpie milk, and Bell Whistles, which can be acquired in the Dream Forest.|winter_story_text>
3.Feature: An accidental recipe but with great nourishing effect.

4.FoodDes: <text|Exuding an ominous Graveborn aura, this uniquely creative seafood delicacy has been a mouth-watering hit for many foodies who have tired of mundane fare.|winter_story_text>
4.WeirdFoodDes: <text|When it comes to Graveborn cuisine, a strong visual impact is to be expected.|actCook_italic>
4.IngrShortDes: <text|The key ingredients are ‌Blue-spine cod and soul snatcher sauce, which can be acquired on the Hermit Isle.|winter_story_text>
4.Feature: A uniquely creative dish that has stolen the hearts of many foodies.

5.FoodDes: <text|Original a stew casually made by Mauler hunters, this dish has been meticulously modified by chefs to finally lock down its exotic aroma.|winter_story_text>
5.WeirdFoodDes: <text|A pot of soup must be a ground-shattering feat if it can also attract eyeballs with its appearance.|actCook_italic>
5.IngrShortDes: <text|The key ingredients are Short-tail Veal Steak, Steelthorn Hens, and Chieftain's Peak Bok-choy, which can be found in the Sandstorm Dunes.|winter_story_text>
5.Feature: This dish is full of exotic fragrance, the result of meticulous refinement by various chefs.

6.FoodDes: <text|A cold summer drink that was once the darling of high society in Savannah and Oakenfell, it glows blue on summer nights.|winter_story_text>
6.IngrShortDes: <text|The key ingredients are Lanternberry Jam and Oval Citrus, which can be acquired in the Marketplace.|winter_story_text>
6.Feature: Dusksnow Cooler is known for its wondrous visual appeal.

7.FoodDes: <text|A cooling and refreshing vegetable and fruit salad from the Dark Forest, made based on the ideal nutrition combination according to the Wilders.|winter_story_text>
7.WeirdFoodDes: <text|Since it is all raw fruits and vegetables, no-one can create any aroma out of it... or can they?|actCook_italic>
7.IngrShortDes: <text|The key ingredients are Golden Apples, Twin Persimmons, and Succulent Dewdrops, which can be acquired at the Twilight Border.|winter_story_text>
7.Feature: This vegetable and fruit salad is prepared based on the best nutrition combination according to the Wilders.

8.FoodDes: <text|Only the most insane drinks connoisseurs would thirst for such an extreme recipe, yet this groundbreaking idea has fascinated many for the longest time.|winter_story_text>
8.WeirdFoodDes: <text|Rock Orchid is also a precious medicine. Perhaps we could put a different spin on this recipe…|actCook_italic>
8.IngrShortDes: <text|The key ingredients are Rock Orchid‍ and ‌Polar Snowmelt, which can be acquired in the Polar Peaks.|winter_story_text>
8.Feature: The recipe for this drink has only ever been a concept, but this groundbreaking idea has fascinated many for the longest time.
